baseline.notes: The current ranges are a frozen audit of explicitly synthetic 2026-Q3 demonstration inputs only. They are not production evidence, must not be relabelled as 2026-Q4 facts, and cannot be used as fallback values when an upstream release or claim is missing, incompatible, or incomplete.
